narr: Slow moving pulse storms created flash flooding conditions across the region. The storms developed in a very moist, buoyant environment where 2000-3000 J/kg SBCAPE and 1.7-1.9 inch PW values, supported very efficient rainfall rates. Shear profiles were weak from the low levels to 300mb and created a 'pulse-type' behavior.
ev: Flash flooding was reported by the beer distributer and surrounding businesses on Sand Hill Rd by Route 30. A pick up truck was reported trapped by water and a water rescue occurred.
Heavy rain caused Washington Boulevard to begin flooding and it was closed as a result.
Officials reported numerous high water issues across Mahoning Township due to heavy rain. This resulted in multiple roads closed.
Heavy rain created a landslide as well as a flooded roadway on Sunset Drive in the area of Hickory Road. Heavy rock and other debris reported on the roadway.

Heavy rain caused Humphreys Run to rise significantly and out of its banks. A couple feet of moving water flooded Route 130 by Nasters Food. Swift water rescue was performed by the food store. Video from the area showed multiple feet of water flowing around the business, parking lot, and surrounding area.

Received reports of extensive flooding across Unity Township, with Marguerite Lake Rd being significantly effected. Roadways and housing were reported to be inundated with high water. Additionally, a high water rescued occurred on Marguerite Lake Rd.
Flooding was reported near the 2400 block of Lebanon Church Road and 400 block of Saintwood Drive. Additionally, several hours along Shady Ave were reported to be flooded.
Flooding was reported at Rochester Rd and Route 19. Cars were stalled in the high water.
Numerous spots were flooded throughout the town of Slippery Rock. A vehicle rescue also occurred on Arlington Drive from high water.
Heavy rain caused Slate Run to exceed bankfull and flood Slate Run Rd.
Flooding occurred near Dorothy Patch off PA-981. Two individuals were rescued from high water.
Officials reported that about the entire length of Freeport Road in Aspinwall was closed due to flash flooding.
Multiple roadways were reported to be flooding due to high water.
Officials reported flooding in Beallsville, particularly by the Beallsville Rd and Main Street intersection.
A swift water rescue took place on Kiester Rd due to flooding from heavy rain.
